description: Regression corpus for the righter skill. Each case is a piece of copy with the violations a correct review should find, referenced by stable rule id (see SKILL.md principle/error-rule ids, and category ids in data/weakeners.json). Use this manually when editing SKILL.md or the data files: re-review each `input`, and confirm the same ids still get flagged and the `expected_component` (if set) still matches the decision tree. Cases can carry an optional `audience` field (`consumer`, `professional`, or `technical`) that sets the reading tier for that review; without it the tier is `consumer`. Not an automated test suite: there's no scorer here, just a fixed set of known-answer cases.

cases.input: You may want to simply click here to possibly reset your password, which should probably work in most cases.
cases.notes: Stacks hedging, softening, and passive-aggressive politeness weakeners in one sentence; also names 'here' as an interface reference.

cases.input: Your changes were saved by the system — you're all set!
cases.notes: Passive voice ('were saved by the system'), em dash, and a low-stakes exclamation mark on a routine confirmation.

cases.input: You didn't enter enough characters in this field, which is required, so please try again.
cases.notes: Blames the user instead of describing the fix; stacked clause; ends on a preposition-adjacent filler.

cases.input: Due to a network security issue, this action cannot be completed at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
cases.notes: System-framed cause, hollow apology, passive construction ('cannot be completed').

cases.input: Click here to learn more about this particular setting and how it works within the application panel.
cases.notes: Also violates the tooltip length rule in data/components.json (40–60 characters max), well over.

cases.input: An error has occurred. Please contact your system administrator if this issue persists after multiple attempts.
cases.notes: No concrete next step for the user (offloads to 'system administrator'); vague on what actually happened.

cases.input:
Subject: WELCOME!!! You're going to LOVE this — act now to unlock your account!
CTA: Click here
cases.notes: Added `accessible-copy` in 1.6.0: 'Click here' as a standalone CTA says nothing out of context. Also fails references/email.md rules directly: ALL CAPS, multiple exclamation marks, spam-trigger phrase ('act now'), and 'Click here' as a standalone CTA.

cases.input: Heads up: your export finished with 2 warnings you may want to review before sharing this file.
cases.notes: Deliberately ambiguous case for the decision tree: not blocking, not a toast (has follow-up detail), not tied to one form field: exercises the tree's ordinary Inline Alert branch, not the fallback.

cases.input: Click here to read more
cases.notes: 'Click here' and 'read more' both fail out of context. Fix names the object, for example 'Read the privacy policy'.

cases.input: Fields in red need your attention.
cases.notes: Color-only status. Fix names the fields and pairs the color with words, for example '2 fields need your attention: Email and Phone number.'

cases.input: We need your location.
cases.notes: System-framed. No user benefit, and no action that names the permission. Fix leads with the benefit, for example 'See stores near you.' with the action 'Allow location'.

cases.input: No data.
cases.notes: No numbered principle clearly fails here. The failure is against the empty-state component rules in data/components.json: it doesn't say what's missing, and it gives no next step. Component-rule case only.

cases.input: Confirm the exported totals match your statement before you close the month.
cases.notes: ARI 9.7. Passes the professional target (ARI <= 10) and would fail the consumer target (ARI <= 6). The output names the professional tier at the top. Verified with scripts/ari.mjs.

cases.input: Confirm the exported totals match your statement before you close the month.
cases.notes: Same copy as case-13 with no audience given. ARI 9.7 against the default consumer target of ARI <= 6. Proves the default is still consumer. The output prints no tier line.

cases.input: Pick how your team gets updates.
cases.notes: Ambiguous audience: the request says only 'a settings label for our app'. Stays on the consumer tier and prints no tier line. ARI 2.0, under the consumer target.

cases.input: Oops! Nothing found.
cases.notes: A table whose filters removed every row. This is the no-results variant, so the rewrite names the search and offers Clear filters. The title is also one of empty-state's own bad examples.

cases.input: You entered an invalid price.
cases.notes: Attached to one editable cell, so Helper Text under the decision tree. Blames the user and gives no way to fix it. A rewrite says what the field accepts.

cases.input: Import failed — 3 rows have errors!
cases.notes: Contextual to the table and non-blocking, so Inline Alert, not Alert Banner (which is for system-level issues). Also says 'failed' when the other rows may have imported. A good rewrite gives the counts and the choice to continue with the rows that are ready.

cases.input: The system was unable to archive this invoice.
cases.notes: No expected_component: the decision tree has no clear slot for a failed single-row action. Treat the pick as a judgment call, anchored to the row, and record which component was chosen. If this case keeps needing a judgment call, add a row to the decision tree.

cases.input: Ashburn's premier martial arts facility for all ages
cases.notes: Marketing slot. check-slots.mjs also fails it for 8 words against a limit of 7. Passing version: 'Martial arts for all ages in Ashburn' (7 words).

cases.input: Kids and adult martial arts in Ashburn, VA. Brazilian Jiu Jitsu (BJJ), Mixed Martial Arts (MMA), and Krav Maga for every level and every age. Join your first class for free
cases.notes: 31 words against a limit of 12, three sentences, and two acronyms in one sentence. Passing version: 'Jiu Jitsu and Krav MMA for kids and adults. First class free.'

cases.input: We'd Love to Hear From You
cases.notes: 6 words against a limit of 5 and names the mood, not the job. Passing version: 'Ask us anything'.

cases.input: Start free / Book a free class / Start for Free
cases.notes: One action with three labels, and 'Start free' does not say what happens. Passing version: 'Book a free class' everywhere.

cases.input: Jiu Jitsu for kids and adults — first class free.
cases.notes: Marketing copy does not get an em dash carve-out. Passing version: 'Jiu Jitsu for kids and adults. First class free.'
